checks.explanation: getpwnam_r resolves literal t736-cedar with no environment-controlled uid; missing/root/current-client uid are rejected. The resolved uid controls both SO_PEERCRED and memfd-owner checks.

lstat rejects symlink/non-directory runtime root and symlink/non-socket endpoint; both must be service-owned, directory group/other write bits clear. Connected SO_PEERCRED requires exact size, expected uid and positive pid, preventing substitution of a different-uid peer.
Only enabled RDD or explicitly enabled test-client constructor connects. No public API reconnects. available requires original process, live fd and completed mapping and reads state under API mutex.

Shared-state API paths call current_process before taking inherited mutex. Receiver map is DONTFORK. disconnect/destructor unmaps only in original pid, clears state and closes its local fd; child never munmaps a stale inherited pointer.

Client validates magic/version/op/response shape/serial1/session0/status0/reserved0 before mapping and closes received fd on success or failure. Broker requires exact32-byte setup with no rights before backend lease creation.

Client refuses uint32 wrap and validates response version/op/serial/reserved/status lower bound/session. Server requires next serial exactly and disallows SETUP after handshake. Ordinary reply body cannot exceed picture metadata.

Successful OPEN returns session in 1..INT_MAX and records dimensions under mutex. Matching successful CLOSE clears active state. Successful PULL must match both caller/stored session and stored dimensions.

Only status1 with exactly sizeof(picture) reaches copy. Checks enforce nonzero even <=1920x1080 dimensions, exact I420 bytes, caller and slot capacity, active session/dimensions, color_range<=2, colorspace in {0,1,6,9}, reserved0. AGAIN/EOF/error/invalid metadata preserve caller pixels; malformed reply disconnects.
API mutex spans sending PULL, receiving/validating metadata, acquire fence, memcpy and frame assignment. Next request cannot overwrite the slot before current caller owns copied pixels.
Each serve owns a distinct shm created after authenticated SETUP. Body allocation follows setup. Any finish path frees body/map/fd then canonical lease cleanup. Peer maximum remains8.

After bounded frame validation broker copies into peer memfd, executes release fence, releases ordinary RAM frame and sends header/picture only. Backend copy_sample unmaps GstVideoFrame and cedar_pull unrefs GstSample before returning; earlier RAM-frame release does not alter hardware ownership.

lookup/open_context/time validation/retained globals/exit lease cleanup compare text-identical to canonical v1. execute matches after sole declared picture-only length substitution. Active lease and owner-fd checks are retained.

Helper requires unlinked regular exact-size file, owner/dev/inode, exact reported required seals plus F_SEAL_EXEC, no executable mode bits and CLOEXEC. Mapping is PROT_READ/MAP_SHARED, DONTFORK; madvise failure unmaps.
